facts.fact: ECOWAS said its Interconnected System for the Management of Goods in Transit (SIGMAT) is installed in the customs IT systems of every ECOWAS member state except Guinea-Bissau and Cabo Verde, and launched its deployment between Benin and Nigeria at Seme-Kraké.

ECOWAS said its Interconnected System for the Management of Goods in Transit (SIGMAT) is installed in the customs IT systems of every ECOWAS member state except Guinea-Bissau and Cabo Verde, and launched its deployment between Benin and Nigeria at Seme-Kraké.

GNB.note: SIGMAT is a customs system and Guinea-Bissau is named only as not having installed it.
The document names no digital legal text for Guinea-Bissau.

BEN.note: A customs transit system launch is not digital policy as defined here.
